name: gin
setup: python -m zipfile -e dataset.zip . && rm -rf __MACOSX dataset/COLLAB dataset/REDDITBINARY dataset/REDDITMULTI5K && ls dataset
smoke: s=$(date +%s); S=$(( $(printf %s "$RUN_TAG" | cksum | cut -d' ' -f1) % 100000 )); bash gf_harness/run.sh --seed $S --batch_size 32 --iters_per_epoch 50 --epochs 350 --lr 0.01 --num_layers 5 --num_mlp_layers 2 --hidden_dim 64 --final_dropout 0.5 --graph_pooling_type sum; echo wall_s=$(( $(date +%s) - s )); grep -h fold_wall_s out/IMDBBINARY_f0.log out/MUTAG_f9.log; bash gf_harness/emit.sh
